welcome.p1: For more than a century the Waldhaus has stood where the forest meets the water. In 1985 Claudio Bernasconi made it his life’s work; today his son Sandro welcomes guests with the same warmth — and the same stubborn devotion to doing things properly.
welcome.p2: Every one of our rooms is different: in layout, in orientation, in style. What they share is the Engadin — warm stone pine, crisp mountain air, and that view.
